pairing.preprocessing: Subtract each training-subsample stratum mean, then divide by training residual standard deviations; apply the fitted means/scales to the same held-out test wells.
pairing.shuffle: Permute residual RNA rows only within each training-subsample control-by-batch stratum.
pairing.primary_endpoint: Mean per-dimension Pearson correlation on 32 held-out residual native RNA coordinates.
pairing.secondary_endpoint: Mean per-dimension held-out R2; conventional test-mean denominator.
pairing.sampling: Deterministic proportional allocation with at least one observation per stratum, sampled without replacement. Exact pairs and shuffles use identical well subsets.

batch_accumulation.context_seed_rule: Partition RNG seed = split seed + 100000 * zero-based context position in the declared context list.
batch_accumulation.control_population: Intersection of controls present in every batch of a context; use that same set to center each batch.
batch_accumulation.batch_weighting: Equal batch weight for acquisition and held-out averages.
batch_accumulation.primary_endpoint: Median per-control Pearson correlation over 6000 genes with the held-out-batch mean.
batch_accumulation.program_endpoint: Median per-control Pearson across least-squares coordinates on the pinned 32-program basis.
batch_accumulation.sensitivity_interpretation: Overlapping random batch partitions test split sensitivity; they are not independent biological replicates.
